blocks.title: CLI application
blocks.text: Command-Line Interface (CLI) application users ko terminal ya command prompt mein likhe text commands se program ke saath kaam karne deti hai. Is chapter ke tamam programs CLI applications hain.

items: main.py aur greetings.py ek hi folder mein mehfooz karein.
Terminal ya command prompt khol kar us folder mein jayein aur chalayein: python main.py
Output nazar aana chahiye: As-Salaam-Alaikum, everyone!

blocks.prompt: Class activity: calculator.py mein add(a, b) aur subtract(a, b) likhein aur main.py mein 15 + 8 aur 25 - 10 print karein.
blocks.explanation: calculator.py: def add(a, b): return a + b aur def subtract(a, b): return a - b. main.py: import calculator; print(calculator.add(15, 8)) se 23; print(calculator.subtract(25, 10)) se 15. python main.py se chalayein.

items: CLI apps terminal se chalti hain: python main.py; Python ki standard library mein saikron modules hain.
